text:
Lucas: Heads-up: I prototyped a multiplexed shim to accept both the legacy v1 envelope and the new v2 multiplex frame. Quick thread on tradeoffs.

Priya: Nice — what's the parsing flow? do we sniff a header or try fast-fail heuristics?

Lucas: Sniff X-Frame-Type header when present, otherwise run a tiny heuristic on the first bytes and fall back to compat-decoder. Prototyped numbers show ~0.6ms p50 added and one extra ~8KB temp buffer per request.

Tom: 0.6ms isn't a dealbreaker for many endpoints, but main worry is KV cache collisions and cache churn across frame schemas.

Marta: We should namespace KV keys by frame schema id, e.g. `kv:frame:v2:<key>` so caches don't collide. Cheap change.

Priya: Agree. Also add telemetry: tag requests with frame=detected_type so we can slice latency and error rates by frame.

infra-bot: Perf job created: perf/mini-shim-parse (shadow) on canary cluster. Will post numbers when finished.

Lucas: Edge case: some clients claim Accept-Version=latest but still send v1 shapes. Suggest opt-in header `X-Compat-Mode: tolerate-v1` to avoid hard errors during rollout.

Tom: Canary rollout plan proposal: 1) deploy shim in shadow mode (no transform), 2) enable live transform behind tenant flag for 10% tenants, 3) observe errors/latency + automatic fallback rule.

Marta: Operator hooks: ensure we have a rollback flag and a circuit that falls back to the compat-decoder if failures > 1% or latency regresses > 15%.

Priya: Code sketch for sniffing/selector:
```
if headers.get('X-Frame-Type'):
    frame = headers['X-Frame-Type']
else:
    frame = sniff_first_byte(buffer)  # lightweight, < 16 bytes
decoder = DECODERS.get(frame, compat_decoder)
```

Lucas: Action items: Priya — add telemetry tags + unit tests for sniff heuristics; Marta — implement KV namespacing patch; Tom — own rollout playbook + failure thresholds; infra-bot — attach perf numbers when ready. I'll open a short RFC that captures this plan and the safety matrix.

Tom: :thumbsup: also add a GC policy to expire namespaced keys after 90 days to avoid long-term bloat.
